abstract: Cloudways shows 80% off for 2 months with code BFCM802 on its pricing page. The discount lasts two months, and the page shows no end date.

mainEntity.name: What is the Cloudways coupon code?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloudways' pricing page shows 80% off for 2 months with the code BFCM802. We read it on 15 November 2026.

mainEntity.name: How long does the Cloudways offer last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The discount covers the first 2 months of a plan. The page we read shows no end date for the offer, so check it before you buy.

mainEntity.name: How much is Cloudways with the 80% off?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Micro plan on DigitalOcean is $2.80 a month for 2 months, then $14. Small is $5.60, Medium $10.80 and Large $19.80 for the first 2 months.

mainEntity.name: Does Cloudways have a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 5 days on Flexible plans with no card and 3 days on Autonomous plans.

mainEntity.name: Does the code work for existing customers?

acceptedAnswer.text: We could not confirm that. The offer is shown for plans on the pricing page. Ask Cloudways support if you already have an account.
